findings.quote: Artificial intelligence offers significant opportunities. For small states, AI can close distance. It can help overcome scale. And it can put better health care, education, and public services within reach. But these opportunities must be shared. Every country must have a voice in shaping the global rules for AI.
findings.rationale: Supports AI-enabled public services and benefits for small states, equitable access, universal participation in global AI rules, and avoiding new dependence.
